summary: Full backend + frontend testing of EY Finans Platform (Turkish maritime finance app, 11 modules). 47/47 backend pytest cases PASSED including auth, dashboard KPI, payables/receivables CRUD, payments + integration (auto-status update on full payment), 13 master data collections, reports (5 types), notifications/reminders, users/audit-logs and FX. Frontend Playwright run also fully green: login -> dashboard, 6 KPI cards rendered, 86 payable rows from seed visible, slide-over forms open, all 11 sidebar modules navigate without errors, logout works.

design_issues.screen: Initial app load (before token in context)
issues: Two 401 console errors fire on initial Dashboard load because /api/auth/me + /api/dashboard/* are requested before AuthContext has rehydrated. Non-blocking but noisy. Consider gating dashboard queries on auth.ready flag.

action_items: (Optional polish) Guard Dashboard API calls behind AuthContext.ready to eliminate two harmless 401 console errors on initial load.
(Optional polish) Add unit test coverage on partial-payment math path (currently only full-payment path is asserted).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 945 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth/, payables/, payments/, reports/, master/) for maintainability.
CORS_ORIGINS="*" combined with httpOnly auth cookie + credentials would be a problem in production; works in preview because Bearer header is used. Tighten in prod.
GET /api/payables/{pid} and others rely on FastAPI default 200 only; consider explicit response_model + 404 for not found (currently returns null/empty in some paths).
Master data POST sets active default but does not enforce unique names — duplicates possible (low risk for parametric lookups).
test_credentials: admin@eyfinans.com / Admin1234! (admin role, seeded). Working as expected; bcrypt hash + login lockout (5 attempts) verified through code path.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Tests use TEST_ prefixed temp records that are deleted in cleanup step (test_cleanup_integration).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — reusable as regression suite. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Auth via Bearer token from /api/auth/login (token field in response). All 13 master collections, 5 report endpoints, dashboard KPI, payable->payment status integration are covered. Frontend uses data-testid extensively (input-email, btn-login, kpi-*, nav-*, btn-new-payable, row-payable-{id}, btn-logout). Seed has 86 payables, 13 master collections populated, FX rates for 9 currencies all returning OK.
